title: The Season of Isekai Anime: 15 Titles From Another World Releasing in Summer 2026
content:
Summer 2026 is officially here, and it’s looking to be a season packed with isekai with (at least) 14 other world anime releasing. From some of the most anticipated anime like Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 and Mushoku Tensei Season 3, returning heavy-hitters like TenSura Season 4 and Re:ZERO Season 4, and interesting new titles, fans of the genre will have plenty to watch.

Here’s the list of all the upcoming Summer 2026 isekai anime and details on the premieres.

Best 15 Isekai Anime Set to Release in the Summer 2026 Season

• Saga of Tanya the Evil II

• Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3

• That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4

• Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs 2

• Skeleton Knight in Another World II

• The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System

• Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2

• Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke

• Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 4

• From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

• Heroine? Saint? No, I’m an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!

• The Forsaken Saintess and her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World

• Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life

• The World’s Strongest Rearguard

• Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4

• Honorable Mention

Saga of Tanya the Evil II

Voted the most anticipated anime of the season by our fans, the anime will see Tanya Degurechaff returning 9 years after the first season aired in 2017. Studio NUT is in charge of the animation, with Takayuki Yukimoto as the director. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime from July 8.

Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3

Ranking second in the most anticipated poll right behind Tanya, Rudy will also be coming back this season. Studio Bind is also back, and the anime is set to premiere with a double episode in Japan on July 4. The preview for both episodes was released. Crunchyroll has confirmed that the anime will arrive to the platform on July 5.

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4

Another one of the heavy-hitting isekai titles, That Time I Got Reincarnated (TenSura) will be continuing its second of five cours in Summer 2026. The threat of Maribell is gone, but Rimuru still has plenty of enemies scheming behind the scenes. The latest trailer for the second cour introduced the Primordial Demons Testarossa, Ultima, and Carrera .

Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs 2

Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs 2 is an isekai coming to Summer 2026 after over four years. After exposing the corruption of the kingdom’s elite, Leon Fou Bartfort finds himself dragged into even more trouble despite wanting a quiet life. As new rivals, political conflicts, and threats emerge, he will have to continue using his knowledge of the dating sim world to protect the people around him. Studio ENGI is again in charge of the animation , and Crunchyroll confirmed that it will stream the anime from July 8.

Skeleton Knight in Another World II

Returning along with Trapped in a Dating Sim (their first seasons aired at the same time in Spring 2022), Skeleton Knight in Another World is another isekai title coming to Summer 2026. After stopping the plot against the elves, Arc continues traveling with Ariane and Chiyome as new threats emerge across the kingdom.

The anime previously confirmed that Aura Studio would be replacing Studio KAI and HORNETS for the animation production , with Katsumi Ono is returning as director. Crunchyroll will stream the anime from July 4.

The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System

Elma realizes he has been reborn into the world of a game he once played. While everyone looks down on the Heavy Knight class, he knows it has the potential to become the strongest. Using his memories from his past life and his knowledge of the game’s mechanics, Elma sets out to unlock its true power and change his fate. Studio GoHands is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll set to stream the anime from July 2.

Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2

After escaping serfdom and proving the strength of his Summoner class, Allen will set his sights on even greater challenges in Season 2 in the “Hell Mode” life he chose for himself. The anime is continuing after a 3-month break, with HIDIVE set to stream the anime from July 3.

Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke

Another isekai anime continuing with a second consecutive cour in Spring 2026, Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke (Season 4) will show more of Rozemyne’s adventures. WIT STUDIO is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll continuing to stream the anime.

Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 4

Iruma’s life in the demon world is set to continue after getting promoted to He (Rank 5). The official X teased that several major events are still to come in Season 4, including the Deviculum (Grand Noble Gathering), the Descent Ceremony, the Thirteen Crowns Dinner, and the Dem-dol Games . BN Pictures is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll streaming the anime.

From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

After dying without reaching the peak of magic, the great sage Ephtal is reborn 400 years later with all of his memories and power intact. He returns to a world where magic has declined and techniques once considered ordinary are now seen as miracles. Studio EMT Squared is in charge of the animation , with Crunchyroll streaming the anime since June 25.

Heroine? Saint? No, I’m an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!

Melody may be the heroine and saint destined to save the world, but she has no interest in playing that role. After gaining incredible magic, she devotes everything to becoming the perfect all-works maid instead. Just like with the previous entry, studio EMT Squared is in charge of the animation. It also began streaming on Crunchyroll last week, with two episodes out so as of July 1.

The Forsaken Saintess and her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World

Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her late twenties, is summoned to another world as a saint but soon finds herself abandoned. Armed with the powerful skills “Motor Home” and “Survival,” she decides to embrace her new life by traveling at her own pace, camping, and cooking delicious meals. This is the third isekai anime by EMT Squared, and it’s set to premiere on July 6. HIDIVE will be streaming it.

Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life

The first and only reverse isekai on the list, this Summer 2026 anime follows Ryusei Narukami as he lives as a reclusive NEET. He is hiding the fact that he is the reincarnation of a Demon King from another world. His quiet life is turned upside down when Meteor Hanaori, the reincarnated Hero who once defeated him, suddenly appears. Studio LIDENFILMS is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll set to stream it from July 11.

The World’s Strongest Rearguard

After dying in a bus accident, overworked salaryman Arihito Atobe is reincarnated in a fantasy world as a Seeker. Although he receives the rare Rearguard class, a support role focused on strengthening allies from the back lines, Arihito quickly discovers how valuable it can be. MAHO FILM is in charge of the animation production , with Crunchyroll set to stream the isekai anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup from July 5.

Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4

And finally, last, but not last, another giant of an isekai anime set to stream in Summer 2026 is Re:ZERO Season 4. The anime is set to continue with Part 2 “The Recapture Arc,” which will run for 8 episodes and should finally give Subaru some wins after everything he went through last season. Studio WHITE FOX is in charge of the animation, with the anime set to continue on Crunchyroll on August 12.

Honorable Mention: Red River

Yuri, a modern-day teenager, is suddenly transported to ancient Anatolia as part of a plot by Nakia, the ambitious Queen of the Hittites. Rescued by Prince Kail before the queen can sacrifice her, Yuri soon finds herself mistaken for the incarnation of the war goddess Ishtar. While not technically an isekai, fans of the genre might be interested as Yuri does find herself so far in the past that it’s practically a different world. Adapting the shojo manga of the same name 24 years after the manga’s ending , the anime will also stream on Crunchyroll.

And that’s it for the Summer 2026 isekai anime! How many will you be watching? Stay tuned for the start of the weekly polls , while you can still vote for the Spring 2026 Anime of the Season .

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Arrives to Netflix Worldwide on July 22
content:
Netflix will officially begin streaming JUJUTSU KAISEN: The Culling Game Part 1 (Season 3) worldwide on July 22. The first part of the arc aired in Winter 2026 in Japan, with Crunchyroll simulcasting it globally. Part 2, The Culling Game Part 2 (Season 4) is currently in production . The anime ranked third in our Winter 2026 seasonal ranking , winning the award for Best Action. You can watch the trailer for the anime below.

ALSO READ: Interview: jo0ji on “Yoake no Uta,” the Ending Theme of Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Part 1

Gege Akutami’s JUJUTSU KAISEN manga officially ended on September 30, 2024. It was serialized for 6-and-a-half-years since March 2018, with the story getting concluded in 30 volumes. Volumes 29 and 30 both released on December 25, 2024. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English. Studio MAPPA previously animated both seasons of the TV anime and movie for the franchise. The story follows Yuji Itadori, a boy with insane physical abilities who ends up joining a school for jujutsu sorcerers after an encounter with Megumi Fushiguro, Satoru Gojo and Sukuna Ryomen. To delay getting executed for eating one of Sukuna’s fingers, Yuji takes on the task of finding and eating the remaining 19 fingers of the ‘strongest sorcerer in history’ in order to try and get rid of him. However, things don’t quite go as smoothly as they’d like.

Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo spin-off manga later began as a short-term serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 41, released on September 8, 2025. The second volume was published on March 4, with the third and final volume releasing in Japan on May 1. The series also released an animated trailer following its conclusion.

ALSO READ: MAPPA Shares Exciting Updates for Its Upcoming Projects, Including Jujutsu Kaisen S4, Chainsaw Man, Special MV & More

The streamer previously also announced that That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 1 is available worldwide.

title: 20th Anniversary Sgt. Frog Film Opens at #4, 2026 Anpanman Film at #5
content:
Kiyoshi Kurosawa 's live-action film adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's The Samurai and the Prisoner ( Kokurōjō ) samurai historical mystery novel dropped from #2 to #3 in its second weekend. The film sold 108,000 tickets and earned 151,785,820 yen (about US$933,800) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 440,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 614,039,360 yen (about US$3.77 million).

The film opened in Japan on June 19, and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 196,000 tickets and earned 274,140,380 yen (about US$1.68 million) in its first three days.

Yen Press released the novel in English, and it describes the story:

The winter of 1578, four years prior to the Honnnoji Incident. Araki Murashige has betrayed his ally Oda Nobunaga and holed up in Arioka Castle—but a string of strange incidents within the castle walls has him at his wits' end. The desperate warlord's only hope in solving these mysteries is imprisoned in the castle's dungeon: a man named Kuroda Kanbei, one of Oda's most gifted strategists. When all the conflict and intrigue reach their end, what will Murashige and Kuroda have up their sleeves?

Yonezawa ( Hyōka , SHOSHIMIN: How to become Ordinary ) and Kadokawa published the novel in June 2021. The novel won the Naoki Prize (a biannual Japanese literary award for new and rising authors), and won Kadokawa 's 2021 Fūtarō Yamada award. It also ranked #1 in the Mystery ga Yomitai! , Shūkan Bunshun Mystery Best 10 , Kono Mystery ga Sugoi! , and Honkaku Mystery Best 10 guidebooks for 2022, and is the first to place at #1 in all four rankings. It ranked at #1 in Rekishi/Jidai Shōsetsu Best 3 (Historical/Period Novels Best 3) award from Asahi Shimbun 's Weekly Asahi magazine in 2021.

Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! (New Sgt. Frog the Movie: The Earth Is in Mortal Peril as Soon as We Come Back!), the new 20th anniversary anime film project for the Sgt. Frog franchise , ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film earned 150,809,200 yen (about US$927,900) in its first three days.

The film opened in Japan on June 26.

Yūichi Fukuda (live-action Gintama , Saint Young Men , HK/Hentai Kamen ) is the supervising director and scriptwriter for the film. Fumitoshi Oizaki ( Sgt. Frog character designer, Romeo X Juliet , Etotama , Akuma Kun , The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl ) directed the anime at Bandai Namco Pictures , and Satoshi Koike ( Etotama , Soul Eater Not! , Princess Connect! Re:Dive season 2) served as character designer. In addition to the opening theme song, ano also performed the "Kashippanashi Destiny" theme song for the film.

In addition to the film, an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime , titled Keroro Gunsō ☆ , will debut in fall 2026. The television anime will have a brand-new cast, while this summer's film still features the existing cast in the franchise .

Soreike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi (Pantan and the Promised Star), the 37th film in the franchise , ranked at #5 in its opening weekend. The film earned 123,462,050 yen (about US$759,600) in its first three days.

The film opened in Japan on June 26.

The film centers on a new character named Pantan, played by guest star Tao Tsuchiya . Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

Hiroyuki Yano , who has directed numerous previous films in the franchise , returned to direct the new film. Shoji Yonemura , a similar veteran of the franchise , penned the film's script. Franchise composers Taku Izumi and Hiroaki Kondō composed the music.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination , and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — dropped from #5 to #8 in its 10th weekend. The film earned 93,170,200 yen (about US$573,300) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 5.64 million tickets, and has earned a cumulative total of 7,757,955,230 yen (about US$47.73 million).

The film opened at #1 at the Japanese box office. The film sold 1.121 million tickets and earned 1,601,093,600 yen (about US$9.96 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in the United States and the United Kingdom on April 1, in other select territories on April 3, and in Japan on April 24.

Illumination founder and CEO Chris Meledandri and Nintendo representative director and fellow Shigeru Miyamoto again produced Illumination and Universal Pictures ' new film. Directors Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic and screenwriter Matthew Fogel returned from the previous film for the new project. Brian Tyler returned to compose the soundtrack.

Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi ( Detective Conan : Fallen Angel of the Highway ), the Detective Conan franchise 's 29th film , dropped from #7 to #9 in its 12th weekend. The film earned 66,912,000 yen (about US$411,700) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 13,453,063,500 yen (about US$82.78 million).

The film is now the fourth consecutive film in the franchise to earn more than 10 billion yen, beginning with 2023's Detective Conan: Black Iron Submarine film.

The film sold 2,318,009 tickets and earned 3,502,137,800 yen (about US$21.9 million) in its first three days, making a new opening-weekend record for the franchise , and debuting at #1 at the Japanese box office.

The new film centers on the character Chihaya Hagiwara, member of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police and the leader of its motorcycle division. Miyuki Sawashiro now voices the character, replacing the late Atsuko Tanaka . The movie also features Kanagawa inspector Jugo Yokomizo, teenage detective Masumi Sera, Chihaya's late younger brother Kenji Hagiwara, and Kenji's Police Academy classmate Jinpei Matsuda.

The 4K restoration of Studio Ghibli 's Kiki's Delivery Service film dropped off the top 10 in its second weekend, but still earned 86,194,100 yen (about US$530,300) from Friday to Sunday. The film's restoration screening has earned a cumulative total of 340,606,800 yen (about US$2.09 million). The restoration screening debuted in Japan at #6. The film earned 173,276,300 yen (about US$1.07 million) in its first three days.

It also ranked #1 in the Mystery ga Yomitai! , Shūkan Bunshun Mystery Best 10 , Kono Mystery ga Sugoi! , and Honkaku Mystery Best 10 guidebooks for 2022, and is the first to place at #1 in all four rankings. It ranked at #1 in Rekishi/Jidai Shōsetsu Best 3 (Historical/Period Novels Best 3) award from Asahi Shimbun 's Weekly Asahi magazine in 2021.

contentBlocks.text: Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! (New Sgt. Frog the Movie: The Earth Is in Mortal Peril as Soon as We Come Back!), the new 20th anniversary anime film project for the Sgt. Frog franchise , ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film earned 150,809,200 yen (about US$927,900) in its first three days.
The film opened in Japan on June 26.

Yūichi Fukuda (live-action Gintama , Saint Young Men , HK/Hentai Kamen ) is the supervising director and scriptwriter for the film. Fumitoshi Oizaki ( Sgt. Frog character designer, Romeo X Juliet , Etotama , Akuma Kun , The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl ) directed the anime at Bandai Namco Pictures , and Satoshi Koike ( Etotama , Soul Eater Not! , Princess Connect! Re:Dive season 2) served as character designer. In addition to the opening theme song, ano also performed the "Kashippanashi Destiny" theme song for the film.

In addition to the film, an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime , titled Keroro Gunsō ☆ , will debut in fall 2026. The television anime will have a brand-new cast, while this summer's film still features the existing cast in the franchise .

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Anpanman films' X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: Soreike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi (Pantan and the Promised Star), the 37th film in the franchise , ranked at #5 in its opening weekend. The film earned 123,462,050 yen (about US$759,600) in its first three days.
The film opened in Japan on June 26.

The film centers on a new character named Pantan, played by guest star Tao Tsuchiya . Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

Hiroyuki Yano , who has directed numerous previous films in the franchise , returned to direct the new film. Shoji Yonemura , a similar veteran of the franchise , penned the film's script. Franchise composers Taku Izumi and Hiroaki Kondō composed the music.

contentBlocks.text: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination , and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — dropped from #5 to #8 in its 10th weekend. The film earned 93,170,200 yen (about US$573,300) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 5.64 million tickets, and has earned a cumulative total of 7,757,955,230 yen (about US$47.73 million).
The film opened at #1 at the Japanese box office. The film sold 1.121 million tickets and earned 1,601,093,600 yen (about US$9.96 million) in its first three days.
The film opened in the United States and the United Kingdom on April 1, in other select territories on April 3, and in Japan on April 24.

Illumination founder and CEO Chris Meledandri and Nintendo representative director and fellow Shigeru Miyamoto again produced Illumination and Universal Pictures ' new film. Directors Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic and screenwriter Matthew Fogel returned from the previous film for the new project. Brian Tyler returned to compose the soundtrack.

contentBlocks.text: Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi ( Detective Conan : Fallen Angel of the Highway ), the Detective Conan franchise 's 29th film , dropped from #7 to #9 in its 12th weekend. The film earned 66,912,000 yen (about US$411,700) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 13,453,063,500 yen (about US$82.78 million).
The film is now the fourth consecutive film in the franchise to earn more than 10 billion yen, beginning with 2023's Detective Conan: Black Iron Submarine film.

The film sold 2,318,009 tickets and earned 3,502,137,800 yen (about US$21.9 million) in its first three days, making a new opening-weekend record for the franchise , and debuting at #1 at the Japanese box office.

The new film centers on the character Chihaya Hagiwara, member of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police and the leader of its motorcycle division. Miyuki Sawashiro now voices the character, replacing the late Atsuko Tanaka . The movie also features Kanagawa inspector Jugo Yokomizo, teenage detective Masumi Sera, Chihaya's late younger brother Kenji Hagiwara, and Kenji's Police Academy classmate Jinpei Matsuda.

The film's restoration screening has earned a cumulative total of 340,606,800 yen (about US$2.09 million). The restoration screening debuted in Japan at #6. The film earned 173,276,300 yen (about US$1.07 million) in its first three days.

title: Monogatari Reveals Visual and Release Date for Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre New Episode
content:
Monogatari Series: Off & Monster Season anime is officially continuing with a brand new episode Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre . The episode is set to premiere next winter.

The new installment will focus on Karen Araragi, who is now a first-year high school student. Although her karate master acknowledges her strength, Karen is told she must take the next step in her training by undergoing a solitary mountain retreat in the Oga Three Mountains. The new anime was previously announced alongside the Tsugimonogatari novel .

You can see the first visual below.

The new season of Monogatari previously ran for 14 episodes from July to October 2024, covering the Orokamonogatari , Nademonogatari , and Wazamonogatari arcs, as well as the Shinobumonogatari arc of the Monster Season.

The main staff of the latest anime consisted of:

• Chief Director: Akiyuki Shinbo

• Director: Midori Yoshizawa

• Series Composition: Akiyuki Shinbo, Tou Fuyashi

• Character Design/Chief Animation Director: Akio Watanabe

• Chief Animation Directors: Kana Miyai, Nobuhiro Sugiyama, Hiroki Yamamura

• Music: Kei Haneoka, Satoru Kosaki, Yuria Miyazono

• Studio: SHAFT

The anime is based on the Japanese light novel series written by Nisio Isin and illustrated by Vofan. The novel has been serialized by Kodansha since 2006, with 29 volumes released as of May 2023. Kodansha USA licensed it in English. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story:

While Koyomi Araragi’s time may be ending, the journey continues with the girls he’s saved. Their own tales of struggles and supernatural threats once thought to be resolved are far from over. From the past to the future, discover their stories, challenges, and intertwined destinies they now face in the wake of Araragi’s departure.
author: Anime Corner

title: Monogatari Off & Monster Season Anime's New Episode Debuts in Winter
content:
Aniplex revealed a new visual and the winter 2026 broadcast for the upcoming " Wazamonogatari : Karen Ogre" episode of the MONOGATARI Series: OFF & MONSTER Season anime on Thursday.

Franchise veteran Akiyuki Simbo is again serving as chief director and Midori Yoshizawa is directing the new episode at SHAFT . Fuyashi Tou returns to oversee the series scripts with Simbo, and Akio Watanabe is also back as character designer and chief animation director.

The anime began streaming exclusively on the ABEMA service in Japan in July 2024. The anime's 14th episode streamed in October 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it was released in Japan.

NisiOisin 's novel series began with the two-volume Bakemonogatari story in 2006, and it served as the basis for the first anime adaptation of the novels in 2009. The novel series' "final season" ended with Zoku Owarimonogatari in September 2014, but it featured a teaser for " Monogatari Series, Next Season Tsugimonogatari ." Tsugimonogatari is the latest novel in the series, and it shipped in October 2025.

Four "Off Season" volumes — Orokamonogatari , Wazamonogatari , Nademonogatari , and Musubimonogatari — shipped in October 2015, January 2016, July 2016, and January 2017, respectively. The volumes tell a series of short stories set at different points throughout the series.

The novel series' "Monster Season" launched with the Shinobumonogatari novel in July 2017. Other novels in the season include Yoimonogatari , Amarimonogatari , Ōgimonogatari , and the two-volume Shinomonogatari novel, which shipped in August 2021. The novels tell a continuation of the franchise , taking place in college.
author: ANN

title: Round1 Launches First Simultaneous United States-Japan One Piece Collaboration in 159 Locations
content:
Round1 has announced its first-ever simultaneous ONE PIECE collaboration across Japan and the United States, with the limited-time campaign running from July 18 through October 17, 2026 at 159 participating locations, including 100 venues in Japan and 59 in the U.S.

The collaboration marks the first time the entertainment chain has launched the same anime event in both countries at once. Fans can expect exclusive merchandise, themed attractions, crane game prizes, bowling and karaoke packages, themed drinks, and promotional giveaways created specifically for the event.

Included is also a set of 10 original One Piece Card Game promotional cards designed exclusively for the Round1 collaboration. In the U.S., fans selected through a registration lottery will be able to collect the cards by reloading their Round1 Game Card during the promotional period, with one card distributed per qualifying reload while supplies last.

The collaboration will also feature exclusive crane game prizes, including Gear 5 Luffy figures, Chopper plush toys, and Straw Hat Crew mini plush collectibles. Guests will also have opportunities to purchase collaboration merchandise through qualifying purchases and limited giveaways, including a One Piece Bounty Rush commemorative pin for eligible arcade credit purchases.

The campaign continues ONE PIECE’s global expansion. Eiichiro Oda’s manga has surpassed 600 million copies in circulation worldwide, while the anime entered the Elbaph Arc earlier this year. Netflix’s live-action adaptation also returned with its second season in March 2026 and has recently wrapped filming for Season 3 ahead of its planned 2027 release. The franchise recently became the first Japanese anime franchise to receive a permanent exhibition at the Grévin Museum in Paris, France.

ONE PIECE also has the upcoming ONE PIECE HEROINES episode coming this week and a new LEGO special animation project releasing on September 29 on Netflix. The remake by WIT STUDIO recently revealed the first trailer and is set to release in February 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Koei Tecmo's Attack on Titan 3 Game Reveals Winter Release in Gameplay Video
content:
Koei Tecmo America announced in a new trailer for its Attack on Titan 3 game on Wednesday the game will debut this winter. MAPPA will produce the opening sequence, which the game will add in a later update.

Koei Tecmo Games describes the game:

Attack on Titan 3 is the riveting culmination of the action game series, depicting the story of Attack on Titan from its Survey Corps beginnings to its dramatic conclusion. Fans can ready their blades for combat against the Nine Titans for the very first time, while learning more about the characters and lore through brand-new story content.

The new game will depict the entire story of the anime from beginning to end.

Koei Tecmo Games and Omega Force's Attack on Titan 2 game shipped for PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in North America and Europe in March 2018, and shipped for PS4, PlayStation Vita, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in Japan in the same month.

The Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle game launched for PS4 and Nintendo Switch in Japan in July 2019, and then launched for PS4, Switch, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in the West one day after the Japanese release. The game is an expansion of the original Attack on Titan 2 game with characters and missions from the anime's third season.

title: The World Is Dancing Anime Gets Special Illustration by Slam Dunk, Vagabond Creator Takehiko Inoue, Reveals Opening Video
content:
The World Is Dancing anime is celebrating its debut by releasing the opening video and a special illustration from the acclaimed manga creator Takehiko Inoue.

Inoue, best known for Slam Dunk and Vagabond , shared a congratulatory illustration of protagonist Oniyasha with a message celebrating the anime adaptation. The tribute is particularly special as The World Is Dancing creator Kazuto Mihara previously worked as one of Inoue’s manga assistants.

The anime was announced earlier this year, set to adapt Kazuto Mihara’s historical manga exploring the origins of Noh theater. Shochiku and CyberAgent are co-producing the series, with animation by Cypic (formerly CygamesPictures ). The first episode premiered on June 29, while fans will have the first chance to watch Episode 2 at its world premiere during Anime Expo 2026 on July 2. HIDIVE is streaming the anime.

The opening video features Macaroni Enpitsu’s theme song “shusho” (“End of the Night”). The staff credits featured in the sequence were hand-written by calligrapher Satoshi Nemoto, who also created the anime’s title logo.

Based on Kazuto Mihara’s historical manga, The World Is Dancing follows Oniyasha, the beautiful young boy who would later become the legendary Zeami, the founder of Noh theater, as he grows up during Japan’s turbulent Muromachi period.

The production has put a strong emphasis on accurately depicting the traditional performances in the anime. Reijiro Tsumura, a Kanze-school Noh performer and Important Intangible Cultural Property holder, is supervising the Noh choreography. Additional choreography is handled by dancer Kaiji Moriyama, who directed the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics Opening Ceremony, and choreographer Mikiko Kawamura. The main staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Toshimasa Kuroyanagi (The Great Passage, Backflip!!)

• Character Design: Keigo Sasaki (The Millionaire Detective, Lonely Castle in the Mirror)

• Calligraphy/Title Lettering: Satoru Nemoto

• Animation Production: Cypic

Story

In 1374, amid the turmoil of the Northern and Southern Courts’ long running conflict, a boy named Oniyasha is born into a family of sarugaku theater performers. He spends his days in a kind of quiet gloom, haunted by a simple but persistent question: Why do people dance? Then, one day, he witnesses a dance that he feels to be “good”—and everything begins to change. This is the story of the beautiful young boy who would one day shape the art of Noh and be remembered as Zeami.

The project adapts Kazuto Mihara’s six-volume manga originally serialized in Kodansha’s Morning magazine. The anime seeks to portray the cultural and personal evolution of Zeami during the late 14th century, at a time when Noh (then known as sarugaku ) was still evolving into a formal art. The English version of the original manga is available on KODANSHA .

title: Street Fighter 6 Game Introduces 'Yasmine Arrives! Fighting Pass' in Video
content:
The official Street Fighter YouTube channel streamed a new video on Wednesday for DLC character Yasmine's "Yasmine Arrives! Fighting Pass" and the other bonuses included in the pass.

The character will join the game on August 3 as part of the Year 4 Character Pass, which will also add Arjun, Bosch, and Final Fantasy VII's Tifa.

The game added Sagat last year on August 5, the first character in the Year 3 Character Pass. C. Viper, the second character in the pass, debuted on October 15. Alex debuted as the third character in the pass on March 17. Ingrid joined the game as the fourth character in the pass on May 28.

The characters in the Year 2 Character Pass included: M. Bison, Fatal Fury crossover character Terry Bogard, Fatal Fury crossover character Mai Shiranui, and Elena. The first round of DLC characters for the game include returning character Rashid, new character A.K.I., returning character Ed, and returning character Akuma.

The game launched in June 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . CAPCOM released the game on Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025, on the console's release date. The Street Fighter 6 Years 1-2 Fighters Edition version also launched in June 2025.

The game's new real-time commentary feature includes commentary from famous fighting game community commentators highlighting aspects of the match as it progresses. The feature has subtitles available in 13 languages, and includes the commentators Thea Trinidad (also known as Zelina Vega), Vicious, Aru, Japanese commentator and caster Kōsuke Hiraiwa, and Sekima II band frontman Demon Kakka (formerly Demon Kogure ).

The game's returning characters include Ryu, Chun-li, and Luke, the final playable DLC character for Street Fighter V . New to the franchise is Jamie, a breakdancing kickboxer. The launch roster also includes characters Manon, Kimberly, Marisa, Lily, JP, Juri, Dee Jay, Cammy, E. Honda, Blanka, Guile, Ken, Zangief, and Dhalsim.
author: ANN

title: AI Animation Company Puri Prince Announces Dennō Isu Tantei Charlotte ~Dead Man's Hand~ Short Anime
content:
Tokyo-based AI animation company Puri Prince announced on Thursday the second installment of its anime project titled Dennō Isu Tantei Charlotte ~Dead Man's Hand~ (Cyber-Chair Detective Charlotte: Dead Man's Hand), a short anime series based on noriyang's web novel Dennō Isu Tantei Charlotte , and also revealed its cast members.

Puri Prince describes the short anime as a "story of records" co-created by AI and humans. The story is set in a near-future society where every event is digitally recorded. Young detective Charlotte — who solves difficult cases without moving from her chair — and her AI partner W.A.T.S.O.N investigate the mysterious game records of a cyber casino, where the winner's name disappears from the records.

Puri Prince stated that the anime series' story unfolds primarily on social media, and viewers will have a unique worldview position as an "observer."

The anime's cast members are (some character name romanizations are not confirmed):

Puri Prince is also developing the full-length feature anime of Yuzuru Kobayashi's "Akumu no Fuchi kara" (From the Abyss of Nightmare) story , the grand prize winner of the Prince JAM! pitch contest for AI x Web3 animation in 2024.

Creative company Creek & River announced in 2025 that its C&R Creative Studios subsidiary had established a specialized anime team, and would begin collaborating with Tokyo-based AI animation company Puri Prince to produce anime by offering their services to other companies and organizations.
